name: Repurchase Agreement Type 1 Choice
definition: Specifies the choice between the major categories of repurchase agreement.

SpecificCollateral.name: Specific Collateral
SpecificCollateral.definition: Repurchase agreement where a single, pre-defined, financial instrument is sold and repurchased.

GeneralCollateral.name: General Collateral
GeneralCollateral.definition: Repurchase agreement where the agreement allows for the sale and repurchase of any of a selection of assets from a pool of eligible assets.
